descriptions.root: The repository itself. Working path: AGENTS.md → module names → module_skills → code.
descriptions.Makefile: Entrypoint of everything — per-asset fanout, JOBS measured from cores and RAM, OMP threads pinned to 1 for determinism.
descriptions.docker-compose.yml: Two services from one image: pipeline, and a loopback-only dashboard on :8900.
descriptions.module_data/: Ingest module — venue downloads, Lean ZIPs, one canonical DuckDB.
descriptions.module_data/ingest.py: Merges venue ZIPs into the one canonical DuckDB (primary-failover, full grid).
descriptions.module_ml/: ML module — bars, features, triple-barrier labels, purged walk-forward XGBoost.
descriptions.module_ml/train.py: Refits expanding folds with HPO-chosen parameters.
descriptions.module_ml/validation.py: Purged walk-forward splits and the frozen final holdout — the gate of the whole system.
descriptions.module_monitoring/: Static dashboard — reads two JSON snapshots, no backend.
descriptions.module_skills/: The contract's companions: the act, the register, the methodologies and the skills.
descriptions.module_visualisation/: This picture: the tracked tree rendered into module_monitoring/repo_galaxy.html on every push.
descriptions.module_visualisation/galaxy_config.json: The whole configuration surface — shape, colour, wording and placement, with no Python edit.
descriptions.store_assets_artifacts/: Versioned per-asset artifacts — the only objects the system produces.
descriptions..github/: The one workflow: a push regenerates the galaxy and commits it back.
